script.name: h1_gateway_panic
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs (port read with tapi_netexpose) and send the malformed requests that could reach the panics at main.rs:30 and main.rs:34 (no target, non-UTF-8 line, 4 MiB line, extreme query values); after each, a valid request on the same port. FAIL if the process exits or a valid request gets no reply (exit code and last stderr line recorded); PASS if a request reached a panic and the process kept serving; UNREACHED, with the inputs tried, if no request reached either line. A second gateway-rs on the busy port is run as a startup input.

script.name: h2_stalled_peer
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go (port read with tapi_netexpose), open a TCP connection, send half a request and stop. Measure the seconds until the server closes the socket, up to 60 s. FAIL if it holds the socket for 30 s or more, PASS if it closes sooner, NOSTART with the errno if the connect fails.

script.name: h3_csharp_bad_input
script.objective: [H3] Start service-cs alone (port read with tapi_netexpose) and send the input that makes the GET inside the try block of Program.cs:85 throw (hops=3 with gateway-rs not listening), plus a valid control (hops=0) and an unparsable value. FAIL if the bad input returns HTTP 200, PASS on 4xx or 5xx. Both status codes and the body are printed.

script.name: h4_go_contract
script.objective: [H4] Start service-go (port read with tapi_netexpose) and send one message that follows the contract (value=1, hops=1) and one that breaks it by the condition of the contract check (value=abc, hops=x). FAIL if the broken message gets a success reply, PASS if it is rejected. Both replies are printed.

script.name: sec_binscan_netexpose_egress
script.objective: [SEC] Run the three services (ports read with tapi_netexpose), send one normal request to each and compare all their outgoing connections (tapi_egress) with an allowed list of loopback only; each unexpected destination goes into the tapi_cybersec_report. Also fail if tapi_netexpose shows a service listening on a non-loopback address. tapi_binscan on gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs adds its result to the report as context only and never fails the test. A scanner that returns no data at all gives INCONCLUSIVE, naming the scanner.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.
